text:
jen: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to add ZephyrX-13B and AuroraLite-7B to the model catalog with updated limits/compat notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

omar: Looking now. Quick question: ZephyrX max_context is listed as 32k in the card but runtime team reported 65k on dedicated recently. Where did 32k come from?

jen: We originally validated 32k on hosted due to tokenization differences. Cal ran a dedicated bench last month showing ~64k stable with quantized kernels. I put 32k under "hosted limits" and added a compatibility note for Dedicated/Private. Maybe the wording needs to be clearer.

cal: @jen correct — dedicated verified 65k seq on T4x2 pools (see bench notes). I added a small sentence in the PR but we should avoid implying hosted supports the larger context unless we actually enable it. Suggest: split limit lines: "Hosted: 32k (confirmed)", "Dedicated/Private: up to 65k (depends on kernel/alloc)"

tess: Also, the benchmark section references long-seq-suite v2 but the link points to v1. I can fix the link but want to confirm which numbers are from v1 vs v2.

docs-bot: :robot_face: Link check failed: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/long-seq-suite -> 404. Mentioned in PR 842.

jen: good catch. Those numbers came from v2 runs; I updated the table locally but missed the link. I'll change the link to v2.

omar: For the SDK snippet, we're currently showing the old parameter name model: "zephyrx-13b-2025". SDK v0.19 added model_id and flavor flags. sdk-eng: can you confirm the snippet we should publish?

sdk-eng: Yep — publish this minimal example instead, it's backwards-compatible and shows the compatibility hint:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model_id="zephyrx-13b",
  flavor="fp16-compat",
  input="Summarize the following...",
  max_tokens=200
)
print(resp.text)
```Use model_id + flavor rather than the magic-suffixed model name. Also add a short note about fallback to "fp16-compat" on hosted if unavailable.

jen: Adding that snippet now. Also included a brief migration note for customers upgrading from the older badge-style names (e.g., zephyrx-13b-legacy -> model_id + flavor mapping).

cal: Could we add an explicit compatibility matrix row for quantized weights? People often ask whether q4/q2 variants match the same latencies. Maybe a tiny table: variant | max_seq | perf_delta.

ryan: +1, and can we surface an example CLI eval command for reproducibility? Something like:```bash
# run long-seq-suite v2 eval locally
scripts/eval/run_bench --model zephyrx-13b --suite long-seq-suite:v2 --out results/zephyrx-13b.json
```that helps SRE/Platform reproduce the numbers.

jen: I'll add both the table and the CLI snippet. One more ask: please review wording in compatibility note. I referenced automatic fallback via routing policy which might be too implementation-y for the public model card. Maybe limit to "automatic fallback to compatible model variants when necessary".

omar: Agreed — keep public docs high-level. Internal docs can have the routing policy details.

tess: I pushed a small change to fix the long-seq link and updated the table captions. PR now at 842 -> updated.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Link check passed for updated file references in PR 842.

sdk-eng: Minor nit — in the snippet we should set flavor to "fp16" rather than "fp16-compat" to match catalog naming. The compatibility sentence can mention the fallback label.

jen: updated to "fp16". Also added a short migration checklist at the bottom with steps: 1) map legacy names -> model_id + flavor, 2) verify max_context on your deployment, 3) run long-seq-suite v2, 4) contact platform for Dedicated kv-cache tuning.

cal: Tiny doc-smithing: change "max_tokens" example to "max_new_tokens" to avoid confusion with total context.

jen: done.

ryan: LGTM from product side. @omar can you sign off host limits wording?

omar: Signed off on hosted numbers. Will follow up with a short internal note about Dedicated configs that folks can reference.

jen: Thanks everyone — merging after CI. I'll backport a trimmed version to the public model cards site (no internal routing details).

docs-bot: :rocket: PR 842 merged to main by jen at 1795007860.
